label: tmux new -s clulix
summary: Create a named session you can find again.

label: tmux ls
summary: List the sessions that currently exist.

label: Ctrl+b c
summary: Create another live window inside the active session.

label: Ctrl+b w
summary: Inspect the windows available in the active session.

label: Ctrl+b %
summary: Split the active window into vertical panes.

label: Ctrl+b "
summary: Split the active window into horizontal panes.

label: Ctrl+b x
summary: Close the active pane while preserving the others.
